locator.title: Грудное вскармливание без стресса: что нужно знать маме
locator.lead: Развеиваем мифы о грудном вскармливании и знакомим с комплексом Фемибион®
locator.caption: Вы можете потреблять то же количество калорий, что и до беременности. Эта стратегия помогает сбросить вес после родов [1]

current_heading.text: Миф 1. Нужно есть за двоих, иначе молока не будет

nearest_text_before.text: Переедание, наоборот, может привести к набору лишнего веса, но не увеличит выработку молока. Качество питания важнее количества: разнообразный рацион поможет чувствовать себя лучше и даст молоку нужные питательные вещества [2]. Например, специалисты рекомендуют съедать больше продуктов, богатых белком, железом и кальцием [3].

nearest_text_after.text: Миф 2. Если пить много чая с молоком — будет больше грудного молока

image_reading: A woman seated at a table holds a fork and knife over a bowl of salad; a second bowl of vegetables, bread, and drinks are visible.
The close tabletop composition makes the meal and her calm, deliberate eating gesture the focal point.
The fork, knife, and salad are the naturally movable visible elements.
analysis.article_context: Body image following the point that breastfeeding does not require double portions: it supports the article’s message that a varied, nourishing meal matters more than overeating.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: A calm, balanced meal illustrates that breastfeeding nutrition is about varied, adequate food rather than larger portions.
structured_intent.primary_action: The woman cuts the salad and lifts one forkful from the bowl.
structured_intent.terminal_state: A forkful of salad is visibly held above the bowl.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The meal remains a calm, nourishing example of balanced everyday eating.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, her knife makes one measured cut while the fork steadies the salad, then the fork gradually lifts a small portion above the bowl. Keep the tabletop framing fixed so the utensils and bowl remain visible. The lift completes near the end, with a brief natural stillness while the forkful stays above the bowl.
models.positive_prompt: The woman calmly cuts through the salad with her knife and lifts a small forkful slightly above the bowl at an even pace. Fixed camera on her hands and meal. In the final frame, the forkful is held clearly above the salad bowl.

models.scene_plan: For this five-second shot, use a smooth, unhurried sequence of cutting into the salad and gathering a portion with the fork. The action progresses continuously into a gentle lift, reaching the readable final position close to the last frames. Keep the camera fixed on the hands, utensils, and meal.
models.positive_prompt: A calm, deliberate bite-preparation gesture: she cuts the salad and gradually raises a forkful above the bowl. Fixed close tabletop view. End with the forkful clearly suspended above the salad.

models.scene_plan: Within four seconds, show a focused, moderate motion: the knife completes a neat cut and the fork collects and lifts a portion. Maintain a fixed camera and a steady pace, with the lifted forkful clearly visible above the bowl by the end.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed close view of the meal as the woman neatly cuts the salad and lifts a forkful above the bowl in one calm motion. The final frame holds the forkful visibly above the salad.
